name: Cosmotron
notes: The 1948 AEC approval is quoted in the page but not modelled as an interval, because intervals earlier than 1950 fall before the timeline epoch.

beam_energy.quote: The machine reached its full design energy of 3.3 GeV in 1953.

summary.plain: Brookhaven's first big accelerator: a ring that in 1953 became the first to send protons to billions of electron volts and the first to deliver a beam outside the machine. It closed in 1966.
summary.technical: Proton synchrotron approved by the AEC in April 1948; reached its full design energy of 3.3 GeV in 1953; first synchrotron to provide an external beam; ceased operation in 1966 and was dismantled in 1969.
